package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_memory_allocation_closure_capture_allocates_in_loop: Layer: Memory allocation. Flag loop-local closures that capture variables in high-frequency paths and may force heap allocation.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario566Positive(values []int) []func() int {
	var funcs []func() int
	for _, val := range values {
		// The closure captures val (the loop variable) by reference.
		// This forces val onto the heap, allocating once per iteration.
		// Using `val := val` at the top of the loop body avoids this.
		funcs = append(funcs, func() int {
			return val
		})
	}
	return funcs
}
